quarterly_data.signal: Partner Eminence Grey: Lumen Technologies and Eminence Grey announced a partnership to deliver sovereign AI infrastructure across the U.S. for government agencies, enterprises and AI innovators, combining Eminence Grey's sovereign AI platform with Lumen's physical infrastructure and programmable network from the edge to the cloud. The partnership is exploring ways for customers to reserve pre-architected or custom-designed infrastructure systems that include Eminence Grey's AI nodes, dedicated GPU/HPC clusters, Eminence Grey-provided Qrypt post-quantum encryption, Lumen's programmable network and Lumen's edge footprint; availability, configuration and implementation details will depend on customer requirements. Jim Fowler (Chief Technology and Product Officer): 'Sovereign AI isn't just about where data lives. It's about how data moves.'
